findings: Expanded the offline BDX catalog to 1,063 descriptors across all eleven recorded bank slots, with 158 behavioral annotations. Added 913 numeric records and 54 descriptions; preserved all 104 prior descriptions and all prior numeric records.

Recorded structural table boundaries, fifteen NULL holes, shared handler aliases, six RET-only handlers and three branch stubs absent from the IDA function inventory. These observations do not establish native index checks or complete handler semantics.

Described all 41 recorded Bank9 calls, including native cameras, object groups, named script transitions and deferred VM retirement. Camera FOV uses radians. The group rebuild parameter counts elements per cooperative yield.

Traced timer message 74 through selected original Event10 scripts, including leave and atk_final_failed requests. Verified six complete original package assets. Actor descriptor operation +160 and wider script effects remain open.

Documented two Actor calls sharing a vector result buffer. The stepped query can return an earlier result; under the stated floating-point and callback assumptions, limits above 2^31 can prevent scalar progress. No retail reachability or live freeze is claimed.

Rechecked the existing dual-form Keyblade fallback for Final, Valor and Master. It validates the form weapon model and offhand animation, falls back to a valid primary Keyblade and checks again after Revert. No native bridge change was made in this release.
Verified the dark offline interface with synthetic data and no visible window. No game, save, mod, Twitch, or live input actions were performed.
